fields.description: Weekly issue featuring editorials condemning loan sharks and wage-buyers (including discussion of high effective interest rates and calls for enforcement), and criticizing greyhound racing as harmful to Miami’s working-class economy. Includes extensive racing coverage and advertisements tied to Tropical Park’s closing day and upcoming Bowie (Maryland) meeting, local society/nightlife columns, and a report on the Biltmore jewel robbery mentioning criminologist R. Hammerhead Greeby. Also notes Federal Housing Administration modernization loans for landscaping and property improvements.
